svg.title: Two Panels: Green Orange
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Two triangular joined panels create an upright triangle; surrounding wall stays transparent. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://collection.carnegieart.org/objects/188e525f-c11a-4a63-b255-7dafd6338eaf; source object 2002.32.3; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
